# 2013 Elections

There was 1 election held in Jersey in 2013.

- **[Grouville Connétable By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2013#e17)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · Turnout unknown

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2013 Grouville Connétable By-Election

By-election following the death of [Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy) in July 2013. (1 seat), 2nd October 2013.

**[John Le Maistre](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre) was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2013**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[John Le Maistre](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre)** |  | 1,001 | 69.4% |
| 2 | [Charles Dix](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/charles-dix) |  | 442 | 30.6% |

1,443 votes

Unknown registered voters
